tools.name: envsense
tools.description: Returns join state, tenant or domain identity, VPN state, OS facts, and other visible environment details.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Runs a shell or PowerShell command on the target endpoint in the simulated incident.

tools.name: read_eventlog
tools.description: Queries Windows or service event logs by channel and filter in the simulated incident.

tools.name: check_time_sync
tools.description: Checks time skew against a domain controller or configured time source.

tools.name: resolve_dns
tools.description: Resolves hostnames or SRV records and returns answers plus observed latency.

tools.name: query_ad_computer
tools.description: Retrieves Active Directory computer-object metadata for the simulated endpoint.

tools.name: query_m365
tools.description: Retrieves Microsoft 365 identity, mailbox, Teams, connector, or Intune state in the simulated tenant.

tools.name: inspect_network_path
tools.description: Checks routing, VPN, MTU, latency, and path characteristics between named endpoints.

tools.name: inspect_policy
tools.description: Compares endpoint, Intune, or Group Policy state against expected assignments.

tools.name: inspect_backup
tools.description: Inspects backup job, catalog, indexing, and restore metadata state.
